blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.
blocks.zh: 大型多式联运模型(LMMs)在视觉理解和生成方面取得重大进展,但在视觉编辑方面仍然面临挑战,特别是在遵循复杂指令,保持外观一致性,支持灵活输入格式方面. 为了研究这一差距,我们引入了RISE Bench,这是评价Reasoning-Informed viSual edit(RISE)的第一个基准,并扩展至RISE Bench++,这是这项新兴任务的更加全面和精细的基准. RISE Bench++ 将分类法扩展为涵盖六个推理维度的分级方案: Temperor, Causal, Space, Logical, 和反事实理性, 以及混合理性, 将多个推理类型整合到多回合编辑中. 这些维度被进一步分解为12个亚类和65个细纹任务类型. 我们扩大输入格式,以包括多图像调制,将基准扩大到1000个人类附加说明的测试案例,以英文和中文发布。 我们还改进我们的评价框架,评估指令合理性、外观一致性和与人类法官的视觉清晰度,以及更可靠和校准判决的LMM-as-judge方法。 除了制定基准外,我们还引入了RISE代理,这是一个无培训代理框架,将推理驱动的规划、工具强化的执行以及核查指导的完善结合起来,在各种RISE任务中表现优于现有最强有力的方法。 我们评价58种视觉编辑方法,包括34种开源模型,19种闭源模型,5种代理方法. 结果显示,基于推理的视觉编辑面临巨大挑战,甚至最强的评价方法是GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst,其准确度仅达到56.6%. RISE Bench++强调了当代编辑模型的局限性,提供了洞察力,并指明了推理意识视觉编辑的未来方向.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large Multi-Modality Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable progress in both visual understanding [ 40 , 2 , 14 , 62 , 45 ] and visual generation [ 55 , 56 , 3 ] .
Meanwhile, significant efforts [ 61 , 83 , 72 , 78 , 15 ] have been dedicated to unifying these two tasks,
with the goal of enhancing overall performance through joint learning.
Some open-source models have demonstrated decent capability in either visual understanding or image generation; however, they still exhibit substantial limitations in general visual editing ( i.e. , transforming an input image based on textual instructions). Specifically, current open-source methods struggle with: (1) accurately following complex editing instructions [ 60 ] ; (2) preserving the original image’s appearance during visual editing [ 30 ] ; and (3) accommodating flexible input formats [ 72 , 83 ] ( e.g. , supporting both single and multiple images with natural language instructions). These limitations severely hinder their practical utility, making them hardly worth rigorous evaluation in this task.
blocks.zh:
大型多相模型在视觉理解[40,2,14,62,45]和视觉生成[55,56,3]方面取得了显著进展.
同时,已作出重大努力[61、83、72、78、15]统一这两项任务,
通过联合学习提高总体业绩的目标。
一些开源模型在视觉理解或图像生成方面表现出了体面的能力;然而,在一般的视觉编辑方面(即根据文字指令来转换输入图像),它们仍然表现出实质性的局限性. 具体来说,目前的开源方法与:(1)准确遵循复杂的编辑指令[60];(2)在视觉编辑过程中保留原始图像的外观[30];和(3)适应灵活的输入格式[72,83](例如,支持有自然语言指令的单相和多相图像. 这些限制严重阻碍了它们的实际效用,使它们在这项任务中不值得严格评价。

blocks.en: Recently, we observed that proprietary models such as the GPT-image series [ 52 ] and the Nano Banana series [ 20 ] have made significant advancements over open-source counterparts [ 77 , 33 , 8 ] . Notably, these models exhibit a remarkable capability in R easoning- I nformed vi S ual E diting ( RISE ) – a sophisticated ability that enables models to make intelligent visual modifications based on contextual understanding and logical reasoning. This ability supports various real-world applications, such as context-aware image modification ( e.g. , adjusting lighting to match a scene’s time of day), intelligent object insertion or removal with semantic consistency, and content adaptation based on inferred user intent. However, traditional image editing models [ 29 , 24 , 6 ] that do not incorporate multi-modal reasoning lack these capabilities. While such a phenomenon is promising, we found that there is no well-established benchmark for systematically evaluating RISE task, making it difficult to quantitatively assess, compare, and further investigate this capability across existing approaches.
blocks.zh: 最近,我们观察到,GPT-image系列[52]和Nano Banana系列[20]等专有型号比开源相机型号[77,33,8]取得了显著进步. 值得注意的是,这些模型在R easoning - I nformed vi S ual E diting(RISE)中表现出了出众的能力 — — 这种精密的能力使模型能够根据背景理解和逻辑推理进行智能视觉修改. 这种能力支持各种现实世界的应用,如上下文感知图像的修改(例如,调整照明以适应场景的日常时间),有语义一致性的智能物体插入或去除,以及根据推断的用户意图对内容进行修改. 然而,传统的图像编辑模式[29、24、6]没有纳入多模式推理,缺乏这些能力。 虽然这种现象很有希望,但我们发现,在系统评价 " 信息、信息和联网 " 任务方面没有既定的基准,因此难以从数量上评估、比较和进一步调查现有办法中的这种能力。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of RISEBench++. We present illustrative example questions from each of the six major reasoning categories: temporal, causal, spatial, logical, counterfactual, and hybrid reasoning, each demanding profound image understanding and reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 图1: RISE Bench++概览. 我们提出六个主要推理类别中的每一个例子问题:时间、因果、空间、逻辑、反事实和混合推理,每一个都要求深刻的图像理解和推理能力。

blocks.en: To this end, we first introduce RISEBench , the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and further extend it to RISEBench++ , a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ organizes reasoning-aware visual editing into a hierarchical taxonomy covering six fundamental reasoning dimensions: temporal reasoning , causal reasoning , spatial reasoning , logical reasoning , counterfactual reasoning , and hybrid reasoning . These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types, providing broad coverage of diverse and reasoning-intensive editing scenarios. To enable comprehensive evaluation, we manually curate a diverse set of high-quality test cases across all six reasoning dimensions, including 200 for temporal reasoning, 200 for causal reasoning, 200 for spatial reasoning, 200 for logical reasoning, 100 for counterfactual reasoning, and 100 for hybrid reasoning, resulting in a total of 1,000 carefully curated and human-annotated samples . Moreover, RISEBench++ supports single-image, multi-image, and multi-turn editing, with each test case provided in both English and Chinese to facilitate bilingual evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们首先引入了RISE Bench,这是专门为评价Reasoning-Informed viSual edit (RISE)而设计的第一个基准,并进一步扩展至RISE Bench++,这是这项新兴任务的一个更加全面而精细的基准. RISE Bench++组织推理-意识视觉编辑为分级分类法,涵盖六个基本推理维度:时间推理,因果推理,空间推理,逻辑推理,反事实推理,和混合推理. 这些维度被进一步分解为12个子类和65个精细任务类型,为多种和推理密集型的编辑方案提供了广泛的覆盖. 为了进行综合评估,我们手动整理了所有6个推理层面的一套多样的高质量测试案例,包括200个时间推理,200个因果推理,200个空间推理,200个逻辑推理,100个反事实推理,100个混合推理,共产生了1000个精心整理和人为附加说明的样本. 此外,RISE Bench++支持单映,多映和多翻编辑,每个测试案例同时提供英语和汉语,以方便双语评价.

blocks.en: For evaluation, we assess the quality of edited output images along three key dimensions: instruction reasoning , appearance consistency , and visual plausibility . Evaluations are conducted using both human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge framework. For the latter, we develop a rigorous evaluation pipeline that employs stronger judge models, incorporates dimension-specific visual and textual evidence, and adopts tailored scoring rubrics, yielding more reliable and well-calibrated assessments. Additionally, we conduct extensive experiments to quantify the correlation between the scores produced by the LMM and human experts, which verifies the reliability and effectiveness of our proposed framework.
blocks.zh: 为了评价,我们按照三个关键方面评估经编辑的产出图像的质量:指令推理、外观一致性和视觉可信度。 利用人类法官和作为法官的LMM框架进行评估。 就后者而言,我们开发了一个严格的评价程序,采用更强有力的法官模式,纳入针对具体维度的视觉和文字证据,并采用量身定做的评分分分数,从而产生更可靠和更精准的评估。 此外,我们进行了广泛的试验,以量化LMM和人类专家的分数之间的关联,这验证了我们拟议框架的可靠性和有效性。

blocks.en: More recently, agentic methods [ 69 , 23 , 100 , 4 ] have emerged as a promising paradigm for augmenting the capabilities of generative models beyond direct generation. Building on this paradigm, we go beyond benchmarking and introduce RISE-Agent , an agentic framework with three collaborative roles: a planner that interprets the editing instruction, reasons about the desired outcome, and invokes external tools when necessary to infer the target state; an executor that realizes the target state using a generative model with a suite of programmatic editing tools; and a verifier that assesses candidate results and decides whether to accept, refine, or trigger replanning. This closed-loop design enables RISE-Agent to reason, execute, and iteratively refine complex visual edits without extra training.
blocks.zh: 最近,代理方法[69、23、100、4]已成为扩大遗传模型的能力超越直接生成的有希望范例。 在这个范式的基础上,我们超越基准,引入RISE-Agent ——一个具有三个协作作用的代理框架:一个规划者解释编辑指令,期望结果的理由,并在必要时引用外部工具来推断目标状态;一个执行者使用一套程序编辑工具的基因模型实现目标状态;以及一个评估候选结果并决定是接受、改进还是触发重新规划的核查者。 这种闭路设计使得RISE-Agent能够在没有额外训练的情况下进行推理,执行,并迭代地完善复杂的视觉编辑.

blocks.en: Using RISEBench++, we systematically evaluate 58 state-of-the-art visual editing approaches, spanning open-source and proprietary models as well as agentic methods. Our evaluation reveals a clear progression in visual editing capabilities. Early open-source models, including BAGEL [ 15 ] , Step1X-Edit [ 43 ] , FLUX [ 34 ] , Emu2 [ 60 ] , and OmniGen [ 82 ] , exhibit limited reasoning ability and consequently struggle across a broad range of test cases. More recent open-source models, such as Qwen-Image [ 77 ] and HunyuanImage [ 8 ] , substantially narrow this performance gap. Nevertheless, proprietary models, including the GPT-Image series [ 52 ] and the Nano Banana series [ 20 ] , generally achieve stronger overall performance, with GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst achieving the best results among all evaluated models. RISE-Agent also achieves highly competitive performance, even outperforming most proprietary models and agentic methods across a broad range of RISE tasks. Notably, recent models already demonstrate strong appearance consistency and visual plausibility across diverse editing tasks, whereas instruction reasoning remains a major challenge, particularly for tasks involving logical and hybrid reasoning. These findings highlight reasoning ability as a key bottleneck and an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 使用RISE Bench++,我们系统评价了58种最先进的视觉编辑方法,包括开源和专有模式以及代理方法。 我们的评价显示,视觉编辑能力有了明显进展。 早期的开源模型,包括BAGEL [15],Step1X-Edit [43],FLUX [34],Emu2 [60],和OmniGen [82],都表现出了有限的推理能力并因此在广泛的测试案例上挣扎. 更近期的开源模式,如Quen-Image [77]和HunyuanImage [8],大大缩小了这一性能差距. 尽管如此,专利模式,包括GPT-Image系列[52]和Nano Banana系列[20],总体上取得了更强的整体性能,GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst在所有被评价模式中取得了最佳效果. RISE-Agent还取得了高度竞争的性能,甚至超越了在一系列广泛的RISE任务中最专有的模式和代理方法. 值得注意的是,最近的模型已经显示出各种编辑任务的强烈外观一致性和可视性,而教学推理仍然是一项重大挑战,特别是涉及逻辑和混合推理的任务。 这些调查结果突出了推理能力,认为这是一个重要的瓶颈,也是未来研究的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: The preliminary version of this work, RISEBench [ 99 ] 1 1 1 Compared with the preliminary conference version (NeurIPS’25, Oral, 0.35%), this journal version introduces substantial extensions in several key aspects: (1) We reorganize the taxonomy from four reasoning categories into a three-level hierarchy of six dimensions, 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types, and expand the benchmark from 360 to 1,000 test cases, newly supporting multi-image and multi-turn settings as well as bilingual instructions; (2) We improve the evaluation pipeline with stronger judge models, dimension-specific evidence and tailored scoring rubrics, and re-validate its agreement with human experts; (3) We develop RISE-Agent, a new agentic framework that augments an open-source executor with explicit planning, external tool use, and verifier-driven refinement, extending this work beyond benchmarking toward methodological exploration of effective solutions for RISE; (4) We expand our evaluation from 8 to 58 visual editing approaches, incorporating the latest open-source and proprietary models as well as agentic methods, and provide an in-depth, fine-grained analysis of failure modes across multiple reasoning dimensions. , was presented as an Oral (Top 0.35%) paper at the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track. The main contributions of this extended work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 本作的初步版本为RISE Bench [99] 11 1 与初步会议版本(NeurIPS ' 25, Orver, 0.35%)相比,本期刊版本在几个关键方面引入了大量的扩展: (1) 我们将分类法从四个推理类别重新组合为六个层面、12个子层面和65个精细任务类型的三级层级,并将基准从360个测试案例扩大到1 000个,新支持多图像和多回合设置以及双语指令;(2) 我们改进评价程序,采用更强大的法官模型、量子证据和量子分数,并重新认证它与人类专家的协议;(3) 我们开发了RISE-Agent,这是一种新的代理框架,通过明确的规划、外部工具使用和核查器驱动的改进,将这项工作扩大到对RISE有效解决方案的方法探索;(4) 我们扩大我们的评价范围,从8个到58个视觉编辑方法,纳入最新的开放源和专有模式以及代理方法,并对多种推理层面的失败模式进行深入而精细的分析。 这一扩展工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: (1) We present RISEBench++, a comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for assessing R easoning- I nformed vi S ual E diting (RISE), comprising 1,000 carefully curated and human-annotated bilingual test cases across single-image, multi-image, and multi-turn settings, establishing a solid foundation for systematic assessment in this emerging area.
blocks.zh: (1) 我们提出RISE Bench++,这是评估R easoning-I nformed vi S ual E diting(RISE)的综合和精细衡量基准,包括1 000个经过精心整理和人为附加说明的双语测试案例,涉及单一图像、多图像和多回合环境,为这一新兴领域的系统评估奠定了坚实的基础。

blocks.en: (2) We define a hierarchical taxonomy of RISE challenges, encompassing six reasoning dimensions that are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types, which allows model capabilities and failure modes to be diagnosed at the level of individual abilities rather than coarse category averages.
blocks.zh: (2)我们定义了RISE挑战的分级分类法,包含六个推理层面,它们被进一步分解为12个子类和65个精细任务类型,这使得模型能力和故障模式能够被诊断为个人能力水平而非粗细类别平均值.

blocks.en: (3) We define three complementary evaluation dimensions and develop a robust LMM-as-a-judge framework that incorporates dimension-specific evidence and tailored scoring rubrics, enabling scalable and automated evaluation that is well aligned with human judgements.
blocks.zh: (3) 我们界定了三个相辅相成的评价层面,并制定了强有力的LMM-as-a-judge框架,其中包含针对具体层面的证据和量身定制的评分分分号,从而能够进行与人类判断完全一致的可扩展和自动化的评价。

blocks.en: (4) We develop RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework combining a reasoning planner, a tool-augmented executor, and a verifier-driven refinement loop, achieving strong performance across diverse RISE tasks and surpassing most proprietary models and existing agentic methods.
blocks.zh: (4)我们开发了RISE-Agent,一个无培训代理框架,结合了一个推理计划员,一个工具强化的执行员,以及一个由核查员驱动的完善环路,在RISE的各种任务中实现强效,并超越了大多数专有模式和现有的代理方法.

blocks.en: (5) We conduct a comprehensive evaluation and analysis of 58 prominent visual editing approaches, spanning open-source models, proprietary models, and agentic methods, revealing key strengths and limitations in their reasoning-informed visual editing capabilities and identifying important directions for future improvement.
blocks.zh: (5)我们全面评价和分析58个突出的视觉编辑方法,涵盖开源模型,专有模型和代理方法,揭示其推理知情视觉编辑能力的关键长处和局限性,并找出未来改进的重要方向.

blocks.en: 2 RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Image Editing Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 图像编辑模型

blocks.en:
Diffusion-based Models Recent advances in image editing have been driven by the rapid development of large-scale generative models. Early diffusion-based editing methods [ 24 , 49 , 6 , 26 , 16 ] demonstrate the feasibility of controllable image manipulation by leveraging pretrained diffusion priors.
Building upon these foundations, recent approaches focus on improving instruction following, visual consistency, and editing generalization through larger-scale training and more diverse editing data. For example, MagicBrush [ 93 ] introduces a large-scale human-annotated instruction-based editing dataset and enables more reliable text-guided image manipulation. FLUX.1 Kontext [ 33 ] , further enhance editing capability by integrating stronger generative backbones with context-aware conditioning. Despite their strong visual generation ability, diffusion-based editors are still primarily optimized for appearance-level transformations and lack explicit reasoning capabilities for complex semantic constraints.
blocks.zh:
基于传播的模式 图像编辑方面最近的进展是由大规模基因模型的迅速发展所推动的。 以传播为基础的早期编辑方法[24、49、6、26、16]通过利用预先训练的传播前科证明可控制图像操纵的可行性。
基于这些基础,最近的方法侧重于通过大规模培训和更加多样化的编辑数据,改进后续教学、视觉一致性和编辑通俗化。 例如"MagicBrush [93]"引入了大规模的人为附加说明的基于指令的编辑数据集,并能够更可靠地进行文字引导的图像操作. FLUX.1 Kontext [33],通过将更强的基因骨干与上下文感应条件相融合来进一步提高编辑能力. 尽管具有很强的视觉生成能力,但基于扩散的编辑器仍然主要被优化用于外观层面的转换,并且缺乏复杂的语义限制的明示推理能力.

blocks.en:
Unified Multimodal Models Beyond diffusion-based architectures, unified multimodal models (UMMs) have recently emerged as a promising direction for image editing by jointly modeling visual understanding, reasoning, and generation.
Open unified models [ 15 , 13 , 67 ] further explore the integration of multimodal understanding and image synthesis within a single framework. For example, OmniGen [ 82 ] focuses on unified and accessible image generation, providing a flexible framework for exploring multimodal generation capabilities.
Large-scale multimodal models, such as Gemini [ 62 ] , demonstrate remarkable capabilities in conversational image generation and editing, where users can iteratively refine images through natural language interactions.
blocks.zh:
统一多式联运模式 除了基于传播的架构外,最近还出现了统一的多模式模式,通过联合建模视觉理解、推理和生成,成为图像编辑的有希望的方向。
开放统一型号 [15,13,67]进一步探索将多式联运理解和图像合成整合在一个框架内. 例如,OmniGen [82] 专注于统一和无障碍的图像生成,为探索多模式生成能力提供了一个灵活的框架.
大型多模式模型,如双子座[62],在对话图像生成和编辑方面展现出显著的能力,用户可以通过自然语言互动来迭代地完善图像.

blocks.en:
Agentic Editing Methods Recent advances in agentic systems have demonstrated strong effectiveness in complex problem-solving scenarios, including code generation [ 87 , 71 , 95 ] , interactive environments [ 22 , 84 , 88 ] , and multimodal reasoning [ 32 , 66 , 1 ] .
Inspired by these advances, recent works have explored agentic reasoning for image editing, moving beyond conventional one-step instruction-based approaches [ 4 , 100 , 74 , 38 , 92 ] .
IntentEdit [ 96 ] and ImAgent [ 69 ] introduce multimodal agents that decompose user intentions into executable editing steps and iteratively refine generated results through perception-action feedback. Mind-Brush [ 23 ] further incorporates external multimodal knowledge retrieval to support editing under complex semantic constraints.
blocks.zh:
代理编辑方法 代理系统最近的进步在复杂的解决问题的情景中表现出了强烈的有效性,包括代码生成[87,71,95],交互环境[22,84,88],和多模式推理[32,66,1].
受这些进步的启发,近期的作品探索了图像编辑的代理推理,超越了传统的一步教学方法[4,100,74,38,92].
IntentEdit [96] and ImAgent [69] 引入了将用户意图分解为可执行编辑步骤的多模式代理,并通过感知-动作反馈来迭代地完善生成的结果. Mind-Brush [23] 进一步纳入外部多模式知识检索,支持在复杂的语义限制下进行编辑.

blocks.en: 2.2 Image Editing Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像编辑基准

blocks.en:
To systematically evaluate generative models, existing benchmarks [ 89 , 28 ] typically measure two key aspects: visual fidelity [ 25 , 57 , 90 ] and semantic consistency with the given instruction [ 27 , 19 ] .
Earlier benchmarks [ 70 , 29 ] mainly evaluate foundational editing capabilities, including inpainting, attribute modification, and layout adjustment. MagicBrush [ 93 ] further extends evaluation to free-form instruction-guided editing and covers both single-turn and multi-turn scenarios. ImgEdit [ 89 ] primarily targets traditional editing tasks where the required operations are explicitly specified and reasoning is not a central concern.
Subsequent benchmarks further expand task coverage and evaluation granularity. For example, AnyEdit [ 91 ] introduces a broader taxonomy of editing operations, while I2I-Bench [ 68 ] evaluates diverse single-image and multi-image editing tasks with fine-grained dimensions covering editing accuracy, content preservation, and visual quality. More recent efforts continue to extend evaluation toward realistic and interactive settings. I2EBench2.0 [ 47 ] incorporates both single-turn and multi-turn editing, enabling the assessment of consistency across successive interactions.
However, these general benchmarks often rely on simple and explicit editing instructions. As model capabilities improve, more challenging evaluations are needed to assess whether models can handle complex and implicit editing requirements.
blocks.zh:
为了系统地评价基因模型,现有基准[89、28]通常衡量两个关键方面:视觉忠诚[25、57、90]和语义上与给定指示的一致性[27、19]。
更早的基准[70,29]主要评价基础编辑能力,包括插图,属性修改和布局调整. MagicBrush [93] 进一步将评价扩展至自由格式的指令指导编辑,并涵盖单回合和多回合两种情景. ImgEdit [89] 主要针对传统编辑任务,其中明确规定了需要的操作,推理不是一个中心问题.
随后的基准进一步扩大了任务范围和评价颗粒性。 例如AnyEdit [91]引入了更广泛的编辑操作分类法,而I2I-Bench [68]则评价了多种单相和多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 最近继续作出努力,将评价扩大到现实和互动的环境。 I2EBennch2.0 [47] 既包括了单回合编辑,也包括多回合编辑,从而能够评估相继互动的一致性。
然而,这些一般基准往往依赖于简单而明确的编辑指示. 随着模型能力的提高,需要更具挑战性的评价,以评估模型是否能够处理复杂和隐含的编辑要求。

blocks.en: 2.3 Reasoning-Informed Benchmarks for Visual Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 为视觉生成制定基准

blocks.en: Image Generation Benchmarks Recent text-to-image benchmarks have increasingly shifted from surface-level prompt alignment toward evaluating whether generative models can reason over implicit knowledge and constraints. Early efforts such as WISE [ 51 ] and Commonsense-T2I [ 18 ] focus on world knowledge and everyday commonsense. They test whether models can move beyond literal word-to-pixel correspondence and generate images consistent with real-world knowledge. Beyond general commonsense, several benchmarks emphasize more structured and knowledge-intensive generation [ 46 , 73 , 9 ] . They move toward discipline-oriented evaluation, covering academic knowledge and knowledge-intensive reasoning across multiple subjects.
blocks.zh: 近期的文字到图像基准日益从地表级的即时调整转向评价基因模型能否超越隐含的知识和制约因素。 早期的努力如WISE[51]和Commonsense-T2I[18]侧重于世界知识和日常常识. 他们测试模型是否能够超越字到相册的对应,生成符合现实世界知识的图像. 除了一般常识外,若干基准强调结构更合理、知识更密集的生成[46、73、9]。 它们转向面向学科的评价,涵盖多个学科的学术知识和知识密集型推理。

blocks.en:
Image Editing Benchmarks Image editing is also evolving toward a reasoning-oriented setting. KRIS-Bench [ 80 ] takes an early step in this direction by organizing knowledge-based editing tasks around factual, conceptual, and procedural knowledge. Related efforts also investigate reasoning processes beyond direct image transformation.
WiseEdit [ 53 ] extends reasoning-oriented editing to more diverse knowledge and interaction settings. It evaluates whether models can infer implicit editing goals from linguistic and visual context, including bilingual and multi-image inputs. UniREditBench [ 21 ] covers a broad range of reasoning dimensions and evaluates both semantic correctness and visual fidelity with dual references.
Moving toward more domain-specific settings, GRADE [ 41 ] evaluates discipline-informed image editing across multiple academic fields. It requires models to apply subject-specific knowledge while maintaining visual consistency and logical readability.
blocks.zh:
图像编辑基准 图像编辑工作也正在向以推理为导向的环境发展。 KRIS-Bench[80]朝这个方向迈出了第一步,围绕事实、概念和程序知识组织以知识为基础的编辑工作。 相关努力还调查了超出直接图像转换的推理过程.
WiseEdit [53] 将面向推理的编辑扩展至更多样化的知识和互动设置. 它评价模型是否能够从语言和视觉背景推断出隐含的编辑目标,包括双语和多图像输入. UninRedit Bench [21] 涵盖了广泛的推理维度,并用双重引用评价语义正确性和视觉忠诚性.
GRADE [41] 在多个学术领域评价学科信息化图像编辑。 它要求模型应用特定对象的知识,同时保持视觉一致性和逻辑可读性.

blocks.en: Video Generation Benchmarks Video generation is also an important component of visual generation. Compared with image generation, it places stronger demands on reasoning correctness because models must account for temporal evolution, motion dynamics, and cross-frame consistency. Physics-IQ [ 50 ] focuses on real-world physical processes and evaluates both image-to-video and video-to-video generation. RISE-Video [ 42 ] studies a broader range of implicit rules in video generation. It evaluates whether models can infer hidden constraints from the input and preserve them consistently as the scene evolves over time across multiple frames.
blocks.zh: 视频生成基准 视频生成也是视觉生成的重要组成部分. 与图像生成相比,它对推理的正确性提出了更强烈的要求,因为模型必须考虑到时间演化,运动动态,以及跨框架的一致性. Physics-IQ [50] 注重现实世界物理过程,评价图像到视频和视频到视频生成两种过程. RISE-Video [42] 在视频生成中研究了更广泛的隐含规则. 它评价模型是否能够从输入中推断出隐藏的制约因素,并随着场景在跨越多帧的时间演变而持续地加以保存.

blocks.en: 3 METHODOLOGY
blocks.zh: 3个方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准概览

blocks.en: Humans possess a deep, conceptual understanding of objects and scenes in the real world that goes far beyond superficial attributes such as color and shape, allowing them to effortlessly envision how a scene would appear after a described change. These capabilities, however, remain highly challenging for current generative models, which struggle to incorporate such reasoning into their visual outputs. As illustrated in Figure 1 , RISEBench++ organizes this ability into six fundamental reasoning dimensions, which can be further grouped into three distinct types of reasoning demand. Temporal reasoning and causal reasoning are primarily knowledge-driven : once the relevant real-world knowledge is available, the target state can often be inferred directly with relatively few intermediate steps. Spatial reasoning and logical reasoning are perception-driven : a model must first infer the latent spatial structure or governing rules from visual observations, and then reason over this inferred representation to derive the target state. Counterfactual reasoning is imagination-driven : a model must draw on real-world knowledge while deliberately overriding it to construct a coherent yet physically impossible state. Finally, hybrid reasoning integrates multiple modes of reasoning across successive turns, evaluating a model’s capacity for long-horizon reasoning by requiring it to correctly resolve each intermediate transformation while preserving the consistency of the evolving scene.
blocks.zh: 人类对现实世界中的物体和场景有深刻的概念理解,远远超出了表面的属性,如颜色和外形,让他们可以无心地想象一个场景在描述的变化后会怎样出现. 然而,这些能力对于目前的基因模型来说仍然是极具挑战性的,这些模型难以将这种推理纳入其视觉输出中。 如图1所示,RISE Bench++将这种能力组织为六个基本推理维度,这可被进一步分为三类不同的推理需求. 时间推理和因果推理主要是由知识所驱动的:一旦掌握了相关的现实世界知识,往往可以用相对较少的中间步骤直接推断出目标状态. 空间推理和逻辑推理都是由感官驱动的:一个模型必须首先从视觉观测中推断出潜在的空间结构或支配规则,然后从这个推断的表示上推导出理由以得出目标状态. 反事实推理是想象力驱动的:一个模型必须借鉴现实世界的知识,同时故意压倒它来构建一个连贯而实际不可能的状态。 最后,混合推理整合了相继转折的多种推理模式,通过要求一个模型正确解决每一个中间转变同时保持演进场景的一致性来评价一个模型的长相推理能力.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , the six reasoning dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. Temporal and causal reasoning span common-sense, contextual, and disciplinary knowledge; Spatial reasoning captures structural and relational understanding; Logical reasoning examines explicit rule deduction and implicit pattern induction; and counterfactual reasoning encompasses counterfactual imagination and anomaly correction/generation. The bilingual word clouds further illustrate the diversity of editing concepts across these tasks. Overall, RISEBench++ comprises 1,000 diverse and carefully curated test cases, with 200 cases each for temporal, causal, spatial, and logical reasoning, and 100 cases each for counterfactual and hybrid reasoning.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,六个推理维度被进一步分解为12个子类和65个细纹任务类型. 时间推理和因果推理跨越常识、背景和学科知识; 空间推理抓住结构和关系理解; 逻辑推理审查明确的规则推理和隐含模式诱导; 反事实推理包括反事实想象和异常修正/生成。 双语词云进一步说明了这些任务中编辑概念的多样性. 总体而言,RISE Bench++包含1000个多样且精心整理的测试案例,其中时间,因果,空间和逻辑推理各有200个案例,反事实和混合推理各有100个案例.

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the comparison between RISEBench++ and existing image-editing benchmarks. Our benchmark offers several key advantages over existing studies: (i) it adopts a more comprehensive evaluation setting, jointly considering reasoning ability, multi-turn interaction, multi-image inputs, and agent support; (ii) it provides broader task coverage, with 65 fine-grained task types and 1,000 samples spanning diverse reasoning scenarios; (iii) it evaluates 58 representative models, offering a large-scale comparison across different model families; and (iv) it supports both English and Chinese, facilitating evaluation across multilingual instruction settings.
blocks.zh: 表1总结了RISE Bench++与现有图像编辑基准的比较. 我们的基准比现有研究具有若干关键优势:(一) 采用更全面的评价设置,共同考虑推理能力、多回合互动、多图像输入和代理支持;(二) 提供更广泛的任务范围,包括65个精细任务类型和1 000个样本,涵盖不同的推理情景;(三) 评价58个代表性模型,提供不同模式家庭的大规模比较;(四) 支持英文和中文,促进跨多语教学环境的评价。

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准建设

blocks.en: RISEBench++ encompasses six major reasoning categories: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, Counterfactual, and Hybrid Reasoning. For each category, we curate a diverse set of high-quality, carefully designed test cases that require both deep visual understanding and precise reasoning.
blocks.zh: RISE Bench++包括了六个主要推理类别:Temperal, Causal, Space, Logical, 反事实和混合理性. 对于每个类别,我们研究出一套多样化的高质量,精心设计的测试案例,这些案例既需要深刻的视觉理解,也需要精确的推理.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Evaluation metrics and pipeline of RISEBench++. RISEBench++ evaluates generated images across Instruction Reasoning , Appearance Consistency , and Visual Plausibility . Gemini-3-Flash evaluates the first two using dimension-specific prompts, while Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite evaluates the third.
blocks.zh: 图3: RISE Bench++的评价指标和管道。 RISE Bench++ 评估生成的图像横跨指令理性、外观一致性和可视性。 双子座-3-Flash使用尺寸特异性的提示来评价前两个,而双子座-3.1-Flash-Lite则评价了第三个.

blocks.en:
Temporal Reasoning. Temporal reasoning tasks evaluate a model’s ability to infer past, future, or intermediate states of objects and scenes. These tasks are primarily knowledge-driven, but require models to ground their inferences in the observed visual state and the specified time, duration, or sequence position. We construct 200 test cases spanning 19 fine-grained task types, organized into three complementary subcategories:
1) Common-Sense Knowledge covers everyday temporal changes in natural and social settings, including life progression, material transformation, natural environmental changes, physical aging, social activities, tool evolution, and urban evolution. These tasks require models to infer how appearance and scene composition vary with growth, degradation, recurring events, or changes across eras.
2) Context Knowledge focuses on image-specific temporal evidence, encompassing temporal state transitions, precise temporal localization, position changes, and action sequences. These tasks require models to interpret visible time indicators, such as clocks and calendars, or ongoing processes and, in multi-image cases, use the observed sequence to infer an earlier, intermediate, or subsequent frame.
3) Disciplinary Knowledge draws on physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, geography, history, medicine, and computer science. These tasks assess knowledge-based temporal inference, as in chemical reactions, biological regeneration, historical scene reconstruction, etc.
Overall, these subcategories assess the integration of temporal knowledge, visual grounding, and state inference, requiring edits to satisfy the requested temporal conditions while remaining visually coherent.
blocks.zh:
时间原因。 时间推理任务评价一个模型推断过去、未来或中间物体和场景状态的能力。 这些任务主要是由知识驱动的,但需要模型在被观测到的视觉状态和指定的时间,持续时间,或序列位置来进行推断. 我们建造了200个测试案例,涵盖19个精细任务类型,分为三个互补的子类别:
1)常识知识涵盖自然和社会环境的日常时间变化,包括生命进步,物质转化,自然环境变化,身体衰老,社会活动,工具进化,城市进化等. 这些任务需要模型来推断外观和场景构成如何随着生长,退化,反复发生的事件,或者不同时代的变化而变化.
2)"背景知识"侧重于图像特定的时间证据,包括时间状态过渡,精确的时间定位,位置变化,以及动作序列等. 这些任务需要模型来解释可见的时间指标,如时钟和日历,或进行中的过程,并在多图像情况下,使用所观测到的序列来推断出一个更早的,中间的,或后续的框架.
3)"纪律知识"借鉴了物理学,化学,生物学,天文学,地理学,历史学,医学,计算机科学. 这些任务评估基于知识的时间推论,例如在化学反应,生物再生,历史地貌重建等方面.
总体而言,这些子类评估了时间知识、视觉地基和状态推论的整合,要求编辑满足所要求的时间条件,同时保持视觉一致性。

blocks.en:
Causal Reasoning. Causal reasoning concerns how actions, events, or operations change objects and scenes. These knowledge-driven tasks require predictions based on the input images. We construct 200 test cases covering 14 fine-grained task types in three subcategories:
1) Common-Sense Knowledge covers physical state transition, structural damage, and flexible deformation, testing how models use everyday knowledge to predict the effects of actions or events on objects and scenes.
2) Context Knowledge includes magnitude change, reading offset, order relation, and feature mapping. Models use the input images to determine which elements to change and by how much.
3) Disciplinary Knowledge tests how models apply knowledge from physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, medicine, music theory, and computer science to predict outcomes, with tasks involving physical laws, computer science concepts, chemical reactions and so on.
In summary, these tasks assess whether models can reason from a specified cause and the initial visual state to the resulting changes, including effects not explicitly stated in the instruction.
blocks.zh:
由是因缘. 原因推理涉及动作,事件,或操作如何改变对象和场景. 这些由知识驱动的任务需要基于输入图像的预测. 我们构建200个测试案例,涵盖14个精细任务类型,分为三个亚类:
1)常识知识 涵盖物理状态过渡,结构损害,以及灵活的变形,测试模型如何利用日常知识来预测动作或事件对物体和场景的影响.
2) 上下文知识包括量变化,读取偏移,顺序关系,和特征映射. 模型使用输入图像来决定哪些元素需要改变并用多少.
3) 纪律知识测试模型如何应用物理,化学,生物学,天文学,医学,音乐理论,计算机科学的知识来预测结果,任务涉及物理定律,计算机科学概念,化学反应等.
简而言之,这些任务评估模型是否能够从指定的原因和初始视觉状态到由此产生的变化进行推理,包括指令中未明确说明的效果.

blocks.en: Spatial Reasoning. Spatial reasoning tasks evaluate a model’s ability to infer spatial relationships and scene structures from visual observations, and to translate this understanding into geometrically coherent edits. These tasks are primarily perception-driven because the required transformations must be grounded in the spatial evidence provided by the input images rather than in linguistic priors. To systematically assess this capability, we construct 200 test cases spanning 14 fine-grained task types, organized into two complementary subcategories: 1) Relation focuses on understanding and manipulating spatial properties and relationships, covering adjacency, direction, orientation, projection, distance, size, configuration, viewing scale, and localization. These tasks require models to identify how objects are positioned, oriented, and related within a scene, and to preserve or modify these relationships according to the instruction. 2) Structure examines the ability to infer coherent object and scene representations, encompassing part-whole perception, geometric regularities reasoning, viewpoint generation, environmental structure reasoning, and egocentric scene reconstruction. These tasks require models to reason beyond isolated visual attributes by understanding how components form a whole, recognizing geometric organization, and reconstructing scenes from different perspectives. These two subcategories evaluate both relational understanding and structural inference, providing a fine-grained assessment of spatially grounded visual editing.
blocks.zh: 空间原因。 空间推理任务评价一个模型从视觉观测中推断出空间关系和场景结构的能力,并将这种理解转化为几何连贯的编辑. 这些任务主要是由感官驱动的,因为所需的转变必须基于输入图像提供的空间证据,而不是语言学前科。 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们构建了200个测试案例,涵盖14个精细任务类型,分为两个互补的子类别: 1)关系注重理解和操纵空间属性和关系,涵盖相接,方向,取向,投影,相距,相距,相接,相接,相接,相接,相接等大小,相接,相接相接相接,相接相接相接,相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 这些任务需要模型来识别物体在一幕中的位置,取向和关联,并根据指令来保留或修改这些关系. 2) 结构研究推断一致物体和场景表现的能力,包括部分整体感知,几何规律推理,观点生成,环境结构推理,以及以自我为中心的场景重建. 这些任务需要模型通过理解组件如何形成整体,识别几何组织,以及从不同角度来重建场景来超越孤立的视觉属性来理性. 这两个子类既评价关系理解,又评价结构推论,对以空间为基础的视觉编辑提供了精细的评估.

blocks.en: Logical Reasoning. Logical reasoning tasks evaluate a model’s ability to interpret visual evidence, establish the relevant rules, and derive solutions that can be expressed through image editing. These tasks are also primarily perception-driven because successful editing requires reasoning over the specific visual configuration, rather than producing a plausible result from linguistic priors alone. We construct 200 test cases across seven fine-grained task types, distinguishing two complementary forms of inference: 1) Explicit Rule Deduction requires models to apply given rules or task constraints to the observed visual state. It includes path searching, mathematical derivation, game deduction, and puzzle solving. These tasks assess whether a model can extract the relevant visual information, carry out structured reasoning, and accurately render a solution that satisfies the governing constraints. 2) Implicit Pattern Induction requires models to infer the underlying regularities from visual observations before determining the appropriate edit. It comprises pattern prediction, visual oddity detection, and rule transfer, testing the ability to complete a pattern, identify an element that violates a shared regularity, or apply an inferred rule to a new visual instance. These two subcategories assess the connection between visual perception, rule-based inference, and precise visual realization.
blocks.zh: 逻辑理性. 逻辑推理任务评价一个模型解释视觉证据的能力,建立相关规则,并得出可以通过图像编辑表达的解决方案. 这些任务主要是由感官驱动的,因为成功的编辑需要对具体的视觉配置进行推理,而不是仅仅从语言学前科中产生一个可信的结果. 我们在7个精细任务类型中构建了200个测试案例,区分了两种互补的推断形式: (1) 明确的规则推理要求模型对所观察到的视觉状态适用特定规则或任务限制。 它包括路径搜索,数学推导,游戏推理,和解谜等. 这些任务评估一个模型是否能够提取出相关的视觉信息,进行结构化推理,并准确地做出一个能满足制约的解决方案. 2) 隐性模式入门要求模型在确定适当的编辑之前,从视觉观察中推断出基本规律. 它包括模式预测、视觉奇异性检测和规则转移、测试完成模式的能力、确定违反共同规律的要素或对新的视觉实例适用推定规则。 这两个子类评估了视觉感知,基于规则的推论,以及精确的视觉实现之间的联系.

blocks.en:
Counterfactual Reasoning. Counterfactual reasoning tests two abilities: using existing knowledge to identify and correct visual anomalies, and creating images that contradict common-sense or domain knowledge as instructed. Our 100 test cases cover 11 fine-grained task types in two subcategories:
1) Counterfactual Imagination covers tasks in physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, geography, history, music theory, and computer science. Models must predict and show what would happen if familiar rules or facts were changed.
2) Anomaly Correction and Generation includes anatomical errors in human or animal bodies, structural anomalies within single non-living objects, and relational anomalies between objects or between objects and their environment.
Unlike the first four dimensions, counterfactual tasks require models to reason from existing knowledge while also imagining and creating images beyond real-world constraints.
blocks.zh:
反事实因. 反事实推理测试两种能力:利用现有的知识来识别并纠正视觉异常,并按指示创建出与常识或域知识相矛盾的图像. 我们的100个测试案例包括11个精细任务类型,分为两个子类别:
1)反事实想象涵盖了物理学,化学,生物学,天文学,地理学,历史学,音乐理论,和计算机科学等领域的任务. 模型必须预测和显示如果改变熟悉的规则或事实会发生什么。
2)异常校正和生成包括人体或动物身上的解剖错误,单个非活性物体内部的结构异常,以及物体之间或物体与其环境之间的关系异常.
与前四个维度不同的是,反事实任务需要模型从现有知识中推理,同时想象和创造超越现实世界限制的图像.

blocks.en: Hybrid Reasoning. Hybrid reasoning combines tasks from the five preceding dimensions through multi-turn image editing. We construct 100 test cases with three to five instructions each, linking tasks within or across these dimensions. These tasks require models to combine temporal reasoning for tracking event order and inferring successive states with causal reasoning for predicting the consequences of actions. They also draw on spatial reasoning to maintain coherent scene relationships, logical reasoning to apply task rules, and counterfactual reasoning to imagine alternative conditions and identify or correct visual anomalies. This combination demands long-horizon reasoning and sustained visual consistency: models must track the evolving scene, use intermediate results to guide subsequent edits, and preserve relevant prior edits and visual details across turns. The cases span a range of complex tasks, including chemical experiments, numerical logic puzzles, and everyday scenarios, placing high demands on models’ knowledge across fields and their reasoning, visual understanding, and editing skills.
blocks.zh: 混合理性. 混合推理通过多回转的图像编辑将前五维的任务结合起来. 我们建造了100个试验箱,每个箱有3至5个指示,将这些层面内部或之间的任务联系起来。 这些任务需要模型结合时间推理来跟踪事件顺序,并推断出相继状态与预测行动后果的因果推理. 他们还利用空间推理来维持连贯的场景关系,逻辑推理来应用任务规则,反事实推理来想象其他条件并识别或纠正视觉异常. 这种组合需要长视距推理和持续的视觉一致性:模型必须跟踪正在演化的场景,使用中间结果来指导后续的编辑,并保存相关的前作编辑和跨转弯的视觉细节. 案例涉及一系列复杂的任务,包括化学实验、数字逻辑谜题和日常情景,对模型的各领域知识及其推理、视觉理解和编辑技能提出了很高的要求。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Overview of RISE-Agent. RISE-Agent follows a closed-loop workflow of reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, bridging target-state inference with precise visual realization.
blocks.zh: 图4:RISE-代理公司概况. RISE-Agent遵循了由推理驱动的规划,工具辅助执行,以及验证器指导的完善的闭路工作流程,将目标状态推论与精确的视觉实现相接.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价管道

blocks.en:
Evaluating the quality of reasoning-informed visual editing remains a challenging task. To address this, we first establish detailed scoring guidelines and conduct comprehensive human evaluations along three key dimensions: 1. Instruction Reasoning ,
assessing whether the model correctly interprets and follows the editing instruction; 2. Appearance Consistency ,
evaluating preservation of relevant visual attributes from the original image; 3. Visual Plausibility ,
determining whether the edited regions of the output are coherent, realistic, and physically or logically plausible within context.
Since human evaluation is resource-intensive and difficult to scale, we further adopt an LMM-as-a-Judge approach to overcome these limitations. Given their strong visual understanding and reasoning abilities [ 54 , 81 ] , state-of-the-art LMMs offer a promising alternative for automatic and human-aligned evaluation [ 31 , 11 , 98 , 94 ] . We develop a robust evaluation pipeline (Figure 3 ) leveraging these models to produce scalable assessments.
In the following part, we detail each evaluation dimension:
blocks.zh:
评估推理知情视觉编辑的质量仍然是一项艰巨的任务。 为此,我们首先制定了详细的评分准则,并围绕以下三个关键方面进行了全面的人类评价: 1. 说明理由,
2. 外观一致性,
评估从原始图像中保存相关视觉属性的情况; 3. 可视性,
确定经编辑的产出区域在上下文中是否一致、现实、物理或逻辑上是否合理。
由于人力评价是资源密集型的,难以扩大规模,因此我们进一步采用作为法官的LMM办法来克服这些局限性。 鉴于其强大的视觉理解和推理能力[54,81],最先进的LMM为自动和人相通的评价[31,11,98,94]提供了一个有希望的替代方案. 我们开发了一个强有力的评价管道(图3),利用这些模式进行可扩展的评估。
在以下部分,我们详细介绍每个评价方面:

blocks.en: Dimension 1: Instruction Reasoning. This dimension assesses the model’s ability to accurately understand and execute the given instruction, with particular attention to both explicit directives and implicit requirements embedded within the prompt. A high-quality response not only performs the literal task specified but also captures the underlying reasoning or intended visual effect implied by the instruction. To improve the accuracy of LMMs in assessing instruction reasoning scores, we propose two evaluation methods. First, for samples with simple scenes that are easily describable through comprehensive text, we annotate a reference text , which serves as the ground truth and is used by the LMM to determine if the output image aligns with this description. For samples involving more complex scenes or unique shapes that are difficult to describe in text, particularly in Logical Reasoning and Spatial Reasoning tasks, we provide a reference image that fully matches the desired output. The judging LMM then compares the output image with the reference image to assess whether the instruction has been correctly executed. This approach expands the range of instruction types and ensures that the LMM judgment scores are relatively accurate, with further details illustrated in Figure 3 (left). A full score (e.g., 5) is reserved for outputs that satisfy all explicit requirements and reasoning-dependent conditions in the instruction, indicating robust instruction comprehension and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 尺寸 1:指示理由. 这一层面评估了模型准确理解和执行既定指示的能力,并特别注意明确的指示和即时指令中所包含的隐含要求。 高质量的响应不仅履行指定的字面任务,还捕捉指令所隐含的基本推理或预期的视觉效果. 为了提高LMM在评估教学推理分数方面的准确性,我们提出了两种评价方法. 首先,对于通过综合文本容易被抹去的简单场景的样本,我们注释一个参考文本,该文本作为地面真相,被LMM用来确定输出图像是否与这一描述一致. 对于涉及更复杂场景或独特形状的样本,在文本中难以描述,特别是在逻辑理性和空间理性任务中,我们提供了与所期望的输出完全匹配的参考图像. 判断 LMM 然后将输出图像与参考图像进行比较,以评估指令是否得到正确执行. 这种方法扩大了指令类型的范围,并确保了LMM的判断分数相对准确,详见图3(左). 完全分数(如5分)保留给满足指令中所有明确要求和推理依赖条件的产出,表明有力的指令理解和推理.

blocks.en: Dimension 2: Appearance Consistency. Appearance consistency measures how well the visual elements unrelated to the instruction are preserved between the input and output images. This is particularly important in visual editing tasks, as it distinguishes between models that perform grounded edits based on the original image ( e.g. , native generation models) and those that regenerate scenes from scratch ( e.g. , cascade-based models). The LMM evaluates this metric by comparing the output image with the input image in accordance with the given instruction, as illustrated in Figure 3 (middle). For multi-image inputs, all source images are concatenated into a single composite image, which is then provided to the LMM for consistency evaluation. For tasks involving temporal, causal, or spatial reasoning – where the input is typically a natural image rich in visual complexity – appearance consistency is scored on a continuous scale from 1 to 5, allowing for nuanced evaluation of how well the core scene is preserved post-editing. In contrast, logical reasoning tasks often involve stylized or synthetic inputs with simple layouts. Given their minimalistic structure, consistency in these cases is evaluated using a binary scheme: a score of 5 indicates full preservation of visual properties, while 1 reflects major deviations. This dimension ensures that models not only generate correct content but also do so in a way that respects the visual fidelity of the original input, which is essential for coherent and context-preserving visual editing.
blocks.zh: 尺寸 2:外观相通. 外观一致性测量了与指令无关的视觉元素在输入和输出图像之间保存得如何好. 这在视觉编辑任务中尤为重要,因为它区分了根据原始图像(如原生生成模型)进行有底编辑的模型和从零开始再生场景的模型(如以级联为基础的模型). 如图3(中间)所示,LMM通过按照给定指令将输出图像与输入图像进行比较来评价这一度量. 对于多图像输入,所有源图像被调和成单一复合图像,然后提供给LMM进行一致性评价. 对于涉及时间,因果,或空间推理的任务——其中输入通常是一个具有丰富的视觉复杂性的自然图像——外观一致性在从1到5的连续尺度上被打分,从而可以细微地评价核心场景在编辑后保存的好坏. 相形之下,逻辑推理任务往往涉及有简单布局的分型或合成输入. 鉴于其最小结构,在这种情况下,采用二进制方法评价一致性:5分表示视觉特性完全保留,而1分反映重大偏差。 这一层面确保模型不仅产生正确的内容,而且以尊重原始输入的视觉真实性的方式进行,这对于连贯和上下文的视觉编辑至关重要。

blocks.en:
Dimension 3: Visual Plausibility. The visual quality and realism of the generated image are critical factors in evaluating the performance of generative models. This dimension assesses whether the model-introduced modifications are free from common generation artifacts such as blurriness, unnatural distortions, structural incoherence, or other visual defects. We focus on the modified regions rather than the entire output image to prevent the judge’s bias toward the original image from affecting the evaluation, thereby avoiding unreasonable penalties when the model faithfully preserves its visual characteristics.
To this end, we provide the LMM with both the original and generated images and ask it to assess the visual quality of the modified content, as depicted in Figure 3 (right). For temporal, causal, and spatial reasoning, visual plausibility further considers whether the modified content remains physically coherent and realistic. For counterfactual reasoning, where physically implausible outcomes may be intentional, we only assess perceptual quality and do not penalize violations of physical laws. Visual plausibility is evaluated on a graded scale from 1 to 5, allowing for nuanced differentiation between high-quality and flawed generations. This dimension ensures that, beyond correctness and consistency, the model-induced modifications meet a basic threshold of visual fidelity while avoiding unreasonable penalties for visual characteristics inherited from the original image.
blocks.zh:
尺寸3:可视性. 所生成的图像的视觉质量和现实性是评价基因模型性能的关键因素. 这个维度评估了模型引入的修改是否没有诸如模糊,非自然扭曲,结构不一致等常见的一代文物,或者其他视觉缺陷. 我们关注的是修改的地区,而不是整个输出图像,以防止法官对原始图像的偏见影响评价,从而避免当模型忠实地维护其视觉特征时不合理的处罚.
为此,我们向LMM提供原始和生成的图像,并请它评估图3(右)所描绘的被修改内容的视觉质量. 对于时间、因果和空间推理,视觉可信度进一步考虑修改后的内容是否保持物理上的一致性和现实性。 为了反事实推理,如果物理上不可信的结果可能是故意的,我们只评估知觉质量,不惩罚违反实体法的行为. 视觉可信度按分级等级从1到5进行考核,可以细微区分高品质和有缺陷的一代. 这个维度确保了模型所引发的修改超越正确性和一致性,达到视觉忠诚的基本门槛,同时避免从原始图像中继承的视觉特征受到不合理的惩罚.

blocks.en: The evaluation details, such as the specific instructions provided to judges (human evaluators and LMM-based assessors), carefully selected in-context examples, and the detailed configuration of the LMM judgement, are provided in the supplementary materials.
blocks.zh: 补充材料中提供了评价的细节,如向法官(人评员和基于LMM的评审员)提供的具体指示、精心选取的文字实例以及LMM判决的详细配置等。

blocks.en: During evaluation, all Dimension Scores are normalized to the range [1, 5] and subsequently rescaled to a 100-point scale for reporting. A sample is considered successfully solved only if it achieves scores of 5 on the three metrics, indicating full satisfaction of all applicable evaluation dimensions. Accuracy is then defined as the percentage of samples that are successfully solved out of the total number of test cases. The two complementary metrics offer both fine-grained performance measurement and an interpretable success rate across tasks.
blocks.zh: 在评价期间,所有维度分数都与范围[1、5]正常化,然后调整为100分报告比额表。 只有在三个衡量标准上达到5分的分数,表明所有适用的评价方面都完全满意的情况下,样本才被认为成功解决。 准确性再被定义为在试验病例总数中成功解析出样本的百分比. 这两个互补的衡量尺度既提供精细的业绩计量,又提供可解释的跨任务成功率。

blocks.en: 3.4 RISE-Agent
blocks.zh: 3.4 瑞斯代理公司

blocks.en:
Our evaluation reveals a clear gap between determining what an edited image should look like and actually generating it. Existing editing models can often produce visually plausible and appearance-consistent results when the desired change is explicitly specified, but struggle when the target state must first be inferred through visual understanding, external knowledge, or multi-step reasoning. This suggests that the main bottleneck in RISE lies in reasoning before generation rather than image synthesis itself.
Motivated by this observation, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free multi-agent framework with three collaborative roles: a planner, an executor, and a verifier, as illustrated in Figure 4 . The planner determines the desired target state, the executor realizes it using a generative model or programmatic editing tools, and the verifier evaluates the result and provides feedback for refinement or replanning. Together, these components form a closed loop that enables RISE-Agent to tackle diverse reasoning-informed image editing tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价表明,在确定编辑后图像的外观与实际生成之间显然存在差距。 现存的编辑模型在明确规定所期望的改变时,往往能产生视觉上可信和外观上一致的结果,但在目标状态必须首先通过视觉理解,外部知识,或多步推理来推断时会挣扎. 这说明RISE中的主要瓶颈在于世代之前的推理而不是图像合成本身.
基于这一观察,我们引入了RISE-Agent,这是一个无培训的多代理框架,具有三个协作作用:一个规划者、一个执行者和一个核查者,如图4所示。 规划者确定所期望的目标状态,执行者使用基因模型或程序编辑工具实现,核查者评价结果并反馈以供完善或再规划. 这些组件共同组成了闭环,使RISE-Agent能够处理各种推理知情的图像编辑任务.

blocks.en:
Reasoning-Driven Planning. Given the source image(s) and an editing instruction, the planner operates in two stages. First, it analyzes the visual content and instruction to infer the intended modification. When the task can be resolved using visual evidence and commonsense knowledge, the planner reasons directly. If additional domain knowledge is needed, it retrieves relevant information through web search. For problems that can be formalized as structured computational tasks, it can invoke one of seven carefully designed code-based tools, covering arithmetic, date calculation, grid and graph shortest-path search, Sudoku solving, coordinate geometry, and matrix transformation. These solvers provide reliable intermediate results for formally structured reasoning tasks.
Second, the planner integrates its visual analysis with any retrieved or tool-derived results to construct an explicit target state and determine how the edit should be realized. It then outputs either a standalone prompt for generative editing or a declarative program for programmatic image manipulation.
blocks.zh:
理性驱动规划. 考虑到源图像和编辑指令,规划者分两个阶段运作. 首先,它分析视觉内容和指示,以推断预期的修改. 当任务可以使用视觉证据和常识知识来解决时,规划者直接说明原因. 如果需要额外的域知识,它通过网络搜索检索相关信息. 对于可被正规化为结构化计算任务的问题,它可以引用7个精心设计的基于代码的工具之一,涵盖算术,日期计算,网格和图表最短路径搜索,数多库解析,协调几何,和矩阵转换. 这些解析器为正式结构化的推理任务提供了可靠的中间结果.
其次,规划人员将其视觉分析与任何检索出或出自工具的结果相融合,以构建一个明确的目标状态,并确定如何实现编辑. 然后,它会输出一个单独进行基因编辑的提示或程序图像操纵的宣告程序。

blocks.en: Tool-Augmented Execution. The executor realizes the target state by invoking either a generative editor or programmatic editing tools according to the plan produced by the planner. The generative editor handles tasks that require synthesizing new content or substantially modifying existing content, such as object insertion, state transformation, and appearance adjustment. However, generative models often lack the fine-grained control needed for precise local edits and may inadvertently modify irrelevant regions. This limitation is particularly evident in logical reasoning tasks involving diagrams, grids, charts, and puzzles, where small geometric or symbolic errors can invalidate the result. We therefore equip the executor with a programmatic editing toolkit consisting of 12 deterministic operations, including but not limited to line drawing, polygon rendering, text editing, region recoloring, and content relocation. These operations enable precise drawing, marking, label replacement, cell modification, and element rearrangement. Since the programmatic edits are applied directly to the selected canvas, all untouched pixels remain unchanged. For multi-image inputs, other images can serve as visual references or content sources. Together, generative editing and deterministic programmatic manipulation provide the executor with both the flexibility required for content synthesis and the fine-grained control needed for precise visual editing.
blocks.zh: 工具辅助执行. 执行者通过使用基因编辑器或程序编辑工具,按照规划者制作的计划实现目标状态. 基因编辑器处理需要合成新内容或实质性修改现有内容的任务,如对象插入,状态转换,外观调整等. 然而,基因模型往往缺乏精确本地编辑所需的精细控制,并可能无意中修改无关区域. 这种局限性在涉及图表,网格,图表,和谜题的逻辑推理任务中尤其明显,小的几何或符号错误可以使结果无效. 因此,我们为执行者配备了一个程序编辑工具包,由12个确定性操作组成,包括但不限于行画、多边形渲染、文本编辑、区域再彩色和内容迁移。 这些操作可以精确地绘制、标记、更换标签、修改单元格和重排元素。 由于程序编辑直接被应用到所选择的画布上,所有未被触及的像素都保持不变. 对于多图像输入,其他图像可以作为视觉参考或内容来源. 基因编辑和确定程序操纵共同为执行者提供了内容合成所需的灵活性和精确视觉编辑所需的精细控制。

blocks.en: Verifier-Guided Refinement. After each execution, the verifier evaluates the candidate in terms of instruction following, background consistency, and visual quality, while identifying what has been correctly completed and what remains to be corrected. Based on this assessment, it selects one of three actions: pass , refine , or replan . Pass is selected when the candidate adequately fulfills the instruction without significant consistency or quality issues. Refine is selected when the overall result is correct but contains localized errors that can be repaired without discarding successful content. The verifier then provides a concise correction instruction and determines whether it should be executed generatively or with programmatic editing tools. Replan is selected when the target state has been incorrectly inferred or the current execution strategy is unsuitable. In this case, the failed result and diagnostic feedback are returned to the planner, which produces a new plan from the original input. The loop operates under predefined replanning and refinement budgets to prevent unbounded iteration. Upon termination, the best candidate produced throughout the process is selected as the final output.
blocks.zh: 校验-指导完善. 每次执行后,核查员都从以下指导、背景一致性和视觉质量等方面评价候选人,同时确定哪些工作已经正确完成,哪些有待纠正。 根据这一评估,它选择了三项行动之一:通过、完善或重新规划。 考生在没有明显一致性或质量问题的情况下充分完成指示时,即可选择合格证。 当总体结果正确但含有可修复而不丢弃成功内容的本地化错误时会选择完善. 然后,核查员提供简明的校正指示,并确定是按基因还是用程序编辑工具执行。 当目标状态被错误地推断出或者当前执行策略不合适时,会选择重新规划. 在这种情况下,失败的结果和诊断反馈被退回给计划员,计划员从原始投入中产生出新的计划. 循环在预先确定的再规划和完善预算下运作,以防止无约束地重复. 解雇后,将选择整个过程产生的最佳候选人作为最后产出。

blocks.en: We report accuracy scores on a 100-point scale for English and Chinese instructions in Table 2 and Table 3 , respectively. In our LMM-as-a-Judge evaluation pipeline, Gemini-3-Flash evaluates instruction reasoning and appearance consistency, while Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite evaluates visual plausibility.

blocks.en: Among the evaluated closed-source models, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst demonstrates the highest performance on RISEBench++, achieving an overall accuracy of 56.6% under English instructions. Nano Banana Pro and Nano Banana 2 rank second and third, respectively, reaching accuracies of 54.6% and 50.8%. GPT-Image-2, GPT-Image-2.5 Flare, Luma Uni-1 and Qwen-Image-3.0 also achieve relatively strong performance, with overall accuracies around 45.0%. However, even the best-performing model achieves an accuracy under 60%, indicating that current image editing models still face substantial challenges in reasoning-informed visual editing.
blocks.zh: 在被评价的闭源模型中,GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst在RISE Bench++上表现出了最高的性能,在英语指令下总体精度达到了56.6%. 纳米香蕉 Pro和Nano Banana 2分别排名第二和第三,达到54.6%和50.8%。 GPT-Image-2,GPT-Image-2.5 Flare,Luma Uni-1和Quen-Image-3.0也取得了相对较强的性能,总体的加速率约为45.0%. 然而,即使是表现最好的模型也达到了不到60%的精度,这表明当前图像编辑模型在推理知情的视觉编辑方面仍然面临巨大的挑战.

blocks.en: In temporal, causal, spatial, and counterfactual reasoning tasks, where the required edits can often be inferred from visual content and common knowledge, the leading closed-source models demonstrate relatively strong performance. For example, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst achieves accuracies of 67.5%, 69.0%, 64.0%, and 72.0% on these four categories, respectively. However, when confronted with logical and hybrid reasoning tasks involving more complex constraints and multi-step reasoning, its accuracy decreases substantially to 27.0% and 39.0%. A similar trend can also be observed for other strong models. Nano Banana Pro, for instance, achieves 71.0% accuracy on causal reasoning, while obtaining only 36.0% and 38.0% on logical and hybrid reasoning, respectively. These results indicate that logical reasoning remains a critical bottleneck for reasoning-guided visual editing, while hybrid reasoning also poses substantial challenges due to the need to integrate diverse reasoning tasks across multi-turn edits.
blocks.zh: 在时间,因果,空间,和反事实推理任务中,需要的编辑往往可以从视觉内容和常识中推断出,主要的闭源模型表现出相对强大的性能. 例如,GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst在这四个类别上分别实现了67.5%,69.0%,64.0%和72.0%的速率. 然而,在面临涉及更为复杂的制约和多步骤推理的逻辑和混合推理任务时,其准确性大幅下降至27.0%和39.0%。 其他强型模型也呈现出类似趋势. 纳米香蕉 例如,Pro在因果推理方面达到71.0%的精确度,而在逻辑推理和混合推理方面分别只获得36.0%和38.0%. 这些结果表明,逻辑推理仍然是推理指导可视化编辑的关键瓶颈,而混合推理也由于需要将多种推理任务整合到多回合编辑中而带来重大挑战.

blocks.en: In contrast, a clear performance gap remains between closed-source and open-source models. Among the evaluated open-source models, HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct achieves the highest overall accuracy at 23.0%, followed by Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 at 17.1%, with Qwen-Image-2.1 and FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0 tied at 16.3%. Other open-source models generally achieve considerably lower performance, particularly on logical and hybrid reasoning. Although several methods introduce explicit reasoning processes, such as CoT or reflection, their improvements remain limited. For example, BAGEL with CoT substantially outperforms its base version, while the thinking variants of Step1X-Edit also improve over the base model. However, their overall accuracies are still significantly lower than those of the leading closed-source models, suggesting that explicit reasoning alone does not necessarily lead to successful reasoning-informed visual editing.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,闭源和开源模型之间仍然存在明显的性能差距. 在被评价的开源模型中,HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct实现23.0%的最高总精度,其次是Quen-Image-Edit-2511为17.1%,而Quen-Image-2.1和FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0被捆绑为16.3%. 其他开源模型一般能实现相当较低的性能,特别是在逻辑和混合推理方面. 虽然有几种方法引入了明确的推理过程,如CoT或反射,但其改进仍然有限. 例如,有COT的BAGEL大幅超过其基础版本,而Step1X-Edit的思维变体也比基础模型有所改进. 然而,他们的总体敏锐度仍然大大低于领先的闭源模型,这表明仅凭明确的推理并不一定会导致推理知情的视觉编辑成功.

blocks.en: Regarding agentic methods, RISE-Agent achieves an overall accuracy of 48.0%, demonstrating particularly strong performance on logical reasoning with an accuracy of 39.0%. It also substantially outperforms the other evaluated agentic methods on single-image cases, where MindBrush, IntentEdit, and ImAgent achieve accuracies of 21.8%, 13.2%, and 3.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of agentic frameworks for reasoning-informed visual editing, while also showing that considerable room for improvement remains.
blocks.zh: 关于代理方法,RISE-Agent的总精度为48.0%,在逻辑推理上表现出特别强,精度为39.0%. 它还大大超过其他评估的单像病例的代理方法,其中MindBrush、IntentEdit和ImAgent分别达到21.8%、13.2%和3.5%。 这些结果显示,在推理知情的视觉编辑方面,代理框架具有潜力,同时也表明仍有相当大的改进余地。

blocks.en: For Chinese instructions, the overall trend is largely consistent with the English evaluation. Several strong models maintain relatively stable performance across the two instruction languages. For example, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst achieves overall accuracies of 56.6% and 55.5% under English and Chinese instructions, respectively, while Nano Banana 2 obtains 50.8% and 51.0%. However, the influence of instruction language still varies across different models; for instance, GPT-Image-1 decreases from 31.8% under English instructions to 27.2% under Chinese instructions. Meanwhile, logical and hybrid reasoning remain challenging under Chinese instructions, consistent with the observations from the English evaluation. These results suggest that multilingual instruction following is generally robust for stronger models, while the reasoning difficulty itself remains the dominant bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 对于中文指示,总体趋势与英文评价基本一致. 若干强势模式保持了两种教学语言之间相对稳定的性能. 例如,GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst在英语和中语指令下分别实现56.6%和55.5%的总加速率,而Nano Banana 2则获得50.8%和51.0%. 然而,不同模式的教学语言的影响仍然不同;例如,GPT-Image-1从英语指令下的31.8%下降到了中文指令下的27.2%. 同时,逻辑推理和混合推理在中国的指示下仍然具有挑战性,这与英国评价的意见是一致的. 这些结果表明,所遵循的多语种教学对于更强大的模式一般是强有力的,而推理困难本身仍然是主要的瓶颈。

blocks.en: To gain deeper insights into the strengths and limitations of each model, we further analyze the average performance across three evaluation dimensions, including Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility, as illustrated in Figure 5 . The results show that most recent models already achieve relatively high Visual Plausibility, while leading closed-source models also demonstrate strong Appearance Consistency. In contrast, their performance on Instruction Reasoning remains considerably lower, with a much larger gap across different models. This indicates that the primary bottleneck of current reasoning-informed visual editing has shifted from generating visually plausible images to correctly understanding and executing complex reasoning instructions. In other words, current models are often capable of producing high-quality and visually consistent outputs, but still struggle to determine what should be edited when the instruction requires non-trivial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了更深入地了解每个模式的优点和局限性,我们进一步分析了三个评价层面的平均业绩,包括指令理性、外观一致性和视觉可视性,如图5所示。 结果显示,最近的一些模型已经实现了相对较高的可视性,而领先的闭源模型也表现出了强烈的外观一致性. 相比之下,它们在“指导理由”方面的表现仍然低得多,不同模型之间的差距要大得多。 这表明,当前推理知情的视觉编辑的主要瓶颈已从产生视觉上可信的图像转变为正确理解和执行复杂的推理指示。 换句话说,目前的模型往往能够产生出高质量的和视觉上一致的输出,但当指令需要非三角推理时,仍然难以确定应该编辑什么.

blocks.en: 4.3 Performance across Subcategories
blocks.zh: 4.3 各分类的业绩

blocks.en: We further analyze model performance across fine-grained reasoning subcategories on both the English and Chinese versions of RISEBench++ in Tables 4 and 5 , respectively. Since the English version constitutes our primary evaluation setting, we focus the following discussion on the English results, while providing the Chinese results as a complementary reference.
blocks.zh: 我们还在表4和表5中分别分析了RAISE Bench++英文和中文版本的精细推理子类模型性能。 由于英文版是我们的主要评价背景,我们重点讨论英文成果,同时提供中文成果作为补充参考。

blocks.en: For knowledge-driven temporal and causal reasoning, strong closed-source models generally perform better on tasks involving common-sense knowledge than on those requiring context-specific or disciplinary knowledge. For example, Nano Banana 2 achieves 77.6% on temporal common-sense knowledge, while GPT-Image-1.5 and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst reach 80.0% and 78.8% on causal common-sense knowledge, respectively. In comparison, performance is generally lower and more variable when models must extract image-specific contextual evidence or incorporate specialized disciplinary knowledge. This suggests that leading models can effectively leverage familiar real-world knowledge, but remain less reliable when reasoning requires tighter integration of visual evidence with contextual or specialized knowledge.
blocks.zh: 对于由知识驱动的时间和因果推理,强有力的封闭源代码模型在涉及常识知识的任务方面一般比那些需要特定背景知识或学科知识的工作表现更好。 例如,Nano Banana 2在时间常识知识方面达到77.6%,而GPT-Image-1.5和GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst在因果常识知识方面分别达到80.0%和78.8%. 相比之下,当模型必须取出图像特定背景证据或纳入专业的学科知识时,性能一般较低,而且更可变. 这表明领先的模型可以有效地利用熟悉的现实世界知识,但在推理需要将视觉证据与背景知识或专业知识更紧密地结合起来时,这种模型仍然不那么可靠.

blocks.en: For perception-driven tasks, spatial reasoning is considerably more tractable than logical reasoning. Leading models achieve above 60% accuracy on both spatial relation and structure, indicating relatively strong capabilities in understanding object relationships and scene organization. In contrast, logical reasoning remains particularly challenging. Explicit rule deduction is difficult but still achievable for several models, whereas implicit pattern induction exhibits consistently low accuracy: even the strongest closed-source result reaches only 31.2%. This contrast suggests that applying an explicitly specified rule is generally easier than discovering latent regularities from visual observations and translating them into precise edits. Notably, RISE-Agent achieves 47.2% on explicit rule deduction, outperforming all evaluated closed-source models on this subcategory. This result demonstrates the effectiveness of combining structured reasoning, tool-augmented execution, and iterative verification for tasks that require both accurate deduction and precise realization of the inferred solution.
blocks.zh: 对于感官驱动的任务来说,空间推理比逻辑推理要多得多可牵引性. 领先模型在空间关系和结构上都实现了超过60%的精度,表明在理解物体关系和场景组织方面能力相对较强. 相反,逻辑推理仍然特别有挑战性。 对若干模型来说,明确的规则扣减是困难的,但仍然可以实现,而隐含的模式诱导显示的准确性一直很低:即使最强的封闭源代码结果也只达到31.2%。 这种对比表明,采用明确规定的规则一般比从视觉观察中发现潜在的规律性并将其转化为精确编辑容易。 值得注意的是,RISE-Agent实现了 47.2%关于明确的规则扣减,优于该子类所有评估的封闭源代码模型。 这一结果表明,将结构化推理、工具强化执行和迭代核查结合起来,对需要准确扣减和准确实现所推断出的解决办法的任务,是有效的。

blocks.en: Counterfactual reasoning presents a different pattern. Strong models achieve relatively high accuracy on both counterfactual imagination and anomaly correction/generation, with GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst reaching 71.4% and 73.3%, respectively. This indicates that leading models can often leverage learned real-world knowledge not only to identify violations of familiar rules, but also to deliberately construct outcomes that contradict them when instructed. Overall, the subcategory results reveal a pronounced capability imbalance: current models are increasingly effective at leveraging familiar knowledge and understanding explicit spatial structures, while reasoning from image-specific evidence and, especially, discovering implicit visual rules remain substantially more challenging.
blocks.zh: 反事实推理呈现出不同的模式. 强模型在反事实想象和异常校正/生成上都取得了相对较高的精度,GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst分别达到71.4%和73.3%. 这表明,主要模式往往能够利用所学到的实际世界知识,不仅可以查明违反熟悉规则的行为,而且可以故意构建在接到指示时与之相矛盾的结果。 总体而言,亚类结果表明明显的能力不平衡:目前的模型越来越能有效地利用熟悉的知识并理解清晰的空间结构,而从图像特定证据中推理,特别是发现隐含的视觉规则,则仍然更具挑战性。

blocks.en: 4.4 Fine-grained Analysis by Task Type
blocks.zh: 4.4 按任务类型分列的精细分析

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Radar charts of fine-grained task accuracy (%) on RISEBench++ (EN). Results for seven models across 65 task types in 12 subcategories.
blocks.zh: 图6: RISE Bench++(EN)上的精细任务精确度(%)的雷达图。 12个亚类65个任务类型中的7个模型的结果。

blocks.en: We select seven models—four closed-source models, two open-source models, and one agentic method—for task-level analysis and visualization. Figure 6 shows that several models perform well on material transformation and physical state transition, reflecting their ability to use relevant knowledge to depict changes in appearance and physical state. Reading offset also requires precise editing: even when the numerical value is correct, unnecessary changes to the original display can cause an edit to fail. Pattern prediction remains difficult across all seven models, with accuracy no higher than 25.6%. The results reveal errors in symbol positions and orientations, indicating that appearance consistency and visual plausibility alone do not guarantee accurate instruction reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了7个模型——4个闭源模型、2个开源模型和1个代理方法,用于任务层面的分析和可视化。 图6显示,有几种模型在物质转化和物理状态过渡上表现良好,反映了它们利用相关知识来描绘外观和物理状态变化的能力. 阅读偏移还需要精确的编辑:即使数字值是正确的,对原始显示的不必要的修改也会导致编辑失败. 在所有7个模型中,模式预测仍然困难重重,准确度不超过25.6%。 结果揭示了符号位置和取向的错误,表明外观一致性和视觉可信度本身并不能保证准确的指令推理.

blocks.en: The models also show different strengths within the same reasoning dimension. GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst leads on part-whole perception and viewpoint generation, whereas FLUX.2 Max and Luma Uni-1 excel at egocentric scene reconstruction, showing different strengths in understanding object geometry and combining multiple views into a coherent scene. Nano Banana Pro stands out on flexible deformation and reading offset, showing strengths in predicting the effects of physical changes and accurately updating readings in images. Among the two open-source models, HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct performs relatively well on anatomical anomaly editing (70.0%), while Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 shows a relative strength in geometric regularities reasoning (53.3%). However, both models are less accurate than the four selected closed-source models and RISE-Agent on reading offset and puzzle solving, indicating remaining difficulties with numerical updates and rule-based visual problems. RISE-Agent achieves the highest accuracy on puzzle solving and rule transfer among the seven models, but its accuracy on pattern prediction remains low.
blocks.zh: 模型还显示出同一推理层面的不同优势. GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst在部分全能感知和视角生成上领先,而FLUX.2 Max和Luma Uni-1在以自我为中心的场景重建上表现优异,在理解物体几何学和将多种观点结合到一个连贯的场景上显示出了不同的优势. 纳米香蕉 Pro在弹性变形和读取相抵方面表现突出,在预测物理变化的影响和准确更新图像中的读取方面表现出了优势. 在两种开源模型中,HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct在解剖异常编辑(70.0%)上表现相对较好,而Quen-Image-Edit-2511在几何规律推理(53.3%)中表现出了相对的强度. 然而,这两个模型的准确度都低于四个所选的闭源模型和RISE-Agent在读取相抵和解谜方面的准确度,表明在数字更新和基于规则的视觉上仍存在困难. RISE-Agent在7个模型中实现解谜和规则传输的最高精度,但其在模式预测上的精度仍然很低.

blocks.en: 4.5 Validity of LMM-as-a-Judge
blocks.zh: 4.5 LMM作为法官的有效性

blocks.en: Table 6 : Comparison of different judge models on instruction reasoning, appearance consistency, visual plausibility, and overall evaluation. Lower MAE is better, while higher Spearman correlation is better.
blocks.zh: 表6:不同裁判模式在指导推理,外观一致性,视觉可信度,整体评价等方面的比较. 较低的MAE更好,而较高的斯皮尔曼相关性更好.

blocks.en: To evaluate how well LMM-based judges align with human preferences, we conduct a human evaluation study on a representative subset of RISEBench++. We first uniformly sample 100 cases from the full benchmark of 1,000 samples to preserve a similar data distribution. We then collect outputs from two models (Nano Banana Pro, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511) on these 100 cases, resulting in 200 edited samples in total. Four human annotators independently score each sample using the same evaluation rubric as the LMM judges. We average the human scores and compare them with the scores produced by different candidate judges. The alignment is measured using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Spearman correlation. The results are reported in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价基于LMM的法官如何与人类喜好相适应,我们对RISE Bench++的代表性子集进行了人的评价研究. 我们首先从1 000个样本的全部基准中统一抽取100个病例,以保持类似的数据分布。 然后,我们从两个模型(Nano Banana Pro、Quen-Image-Edit-2511)中收集这100个病例的产出,结果共有200个经编辑的样本。 4名人类注释员使用与LMM评委相同的评分标分,独立评分每个样本. 我们平均人类得分,并将其与不同候选法官的得分进行比较。 校正使用"平均绝对错误"(MAE)和"斯皮尔曼关联"来测量. 调查结果见表6。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 6 , Gemini-3-Flash aligns most closely with human judgments on instruction reasoning and appearance consistency.
It achieves the strongest overall MAE–Spearman trade-off across both dimensions, with high agreement on instruction reasoning (0.48 MAE and 0.84 Spearman). We therefore select Gemini-3-Flash as the judge for these two criteria. For visual plausibility, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite aligns best with human judgments, achieving 0.27 MAE and 0.41 Spearman.
Given its lower inference cost, we adopt it as the visual plausibility judge. These results provide empirical support for our final judge configuration.
blocks.zh:
如表6所示,双子座-3-Flash最接近于人类对指令推理和外观一致性的判断.
它实现了两个维度之间最强的总的MAE-斯皮尔曼取舍,对指令推理(0.48 MAE和0.84 Spearman)达成了高度一致. 因此,我们选择双子座-3-Flash作为这两个标准的法官. 对于视觉的可信度,双子座-3.1-Flash-Lite最能与人类的判断相匹配,实现0.27 MAE和0.41 Spearman.
鉴于其较低的推论成本,我们采用它作为视觉上可信的法官。 这些结果为我们的最终法官配置提供了经验支持。

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Study of RISE-Agent
blocks.zh: 4.6 RISE-代理商的研究

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation study on key components of RISE-Agent, with results reported as accuracy (%). FLUX.2 Klein 9B without RISE-Agent components serves as the baseline. Best and second-best results are shown in bold and underline , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表7:关于RISE-Agent关键成分的研究,结果报告的准确性(%)。 FLUX.2 Klein 9B没有RISE-Agent组件作为基线。 最佳和次最佳成果分别用黑体和下划线表示。

blocks.en:
To better understand the contribution of each component in RISE-Agent, we progressively augment FLUX.2 Klein 9B with the planner, tools, and verifier. As shown in Table 7 , adding the planner alone substantially increases the overall score from 12.9% to 40.5%, with especially pronounced gains on temporal and causal tasks. These results suggest that many failures arise from the difficulty current editors face in both inferring the intended target state and realizing it through a single-step generation process. By explicitly reasoning about the target state and translating it into an actionable editing prompt, the planner alleviates this burden on the editor. In effect, it decouples target-state inference from edit execution, leading to more reliable editing outcomes. The gains on logical tasks are comparatively smaller, likely because correct high-level reasoning alone is insufficient for the precise geometric or symbolic manipulations required by such inputs.
Adding tools further improves performance on logical, causal, and counterfactual tasks, raising the overall score to 42.6%. In contrast, temporal and spatial scores decrease slightly, likely because these categories are dominated by natural-image edits, for which programmatic operations are less suitable than generative editing and may introduce unnatural artifacts or localization errors. Finally, verifier-guided refinement increases the overall score to 48.0% and achieves the best performance in five of the six categories, demonstrating the effectiveness of iterative diagnosis and correction. The limited improvement in spatial tasks may be attributed to the verifier’s limited spatial understanding capabilities. Overall, these results highlight the complementary contributions of the three components, whose integration yields progressively stronger overall performance.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地了解RISE-Agent中每个组成部分的贡献,我们用规划员、工具和核查员逐步扩充FLUX.2 Klein 9B。 如表7所显示的,仅加上计划人员就将总得分从12.9%大幅提高到40.5%,在时间和因果任务方面特别显著。 这些结果表明,许多失败是当前编辑在推断预定目标状态和通过单步生成过程实现这一状态时面临的困难造成的. 通过对目标状态的明确推理,并将其转化为可操作的编辑快取,计划者减轻了编辑的这一负担. 实际上,它将目标状态推论与编辑执行脱钩,导致更可靠的编辑结果. 逻辑任务的收益相对较少,可能是因为仅靠正确的高层次推理不足以满足这些投入所需的精确几何或象征性操纵.
添加工具会进一步提高逻辑任务,因果任务和反事实任务的性能,将总分提高到42.6%. 相形之下,时间和空间分数会略有下降,可能是因为这些类别以自然图像编辑为主,为此,程序操作不如基因编辑,可能引入了非自然文物或本地化错误. 最后,核查者指导的完善将总体得分提高到48.0%,并在6个类别中的5个类别中达到最佳表现,证明了迭代诊断和矫正的有效性. 空间任务的有限改进可能归因于核查者的空间了解能力有限。 总体而言,这些成果突出了这三个组成部分的互补贡献,它们的一体化使总体业绩逐步加强。

blocks.en: 4.7 Qualitative Examples
blocks.zh: 4.7 定性实例

blocks.en: We exhibit several representative model outputs in Fig. 7 and observe several notable characteristics of the evaluated models. In relatively intuitive cases, strong models can often translate the inferred consequence into plausible visual changes, such as depicting the scene ten seconds later, rendering a lunar halo caused by ice-crystal scattering, or placing two cats back to back. More reasoning-intensive cases, however, expose clearer differences across models. For example, models vary substantially in predicting the outcome of adding reagents and localizing the current viewpoint from a map, whereas RISE-Agent correctly captures the expected reaction and identifies the corresponding location. Rule-based transformations remain challenging as well: in the light-switch example, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 alters nearly the entire grid, and several other models produce incorrect cell states, while RISE-Agent applies the operation precisely to the affected cells. This further highlights the importance of not only reasoning about the intended state transition, but also executing it precisely.

blocks.en:
The hybrid cases further expose a different limitation that becomes particularly apparent under sequential editing. Operations such as advancing the clock by one hour, rotating the entire clock by 180 degrees, and subsequently rotating the minute hand clockwise by 3600 degrees require each intermediate result to remain both semantically correct and visually stable for the next edit.
While some models preserve the scene reasonably well across turns, Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 and HunyuanImage-3.0 both exhibit cumulative visual degradation, with later outputs progressively losing structural integrity and visual fidelity. This suggests that errors in multi-round reasoning-informed editing can accumulate not only at the reasoning level, but also through multi-step visual regeneration, making long-horizon consistency an additional challenge beyond solving each individual edit correctly.
blocks.zh:
混合案件进一步暴露出一种不同的限制,在相继编辑下变得特别明显. 诸如将时钟推进一个小时,将整个时钟旋转180度等操作,再由分钟手顺时针旋转3600度等操作,要求每个中间结果在下一次编辑时既保持成像正确又保持视觉稳定.
虽然有些模型在不同转弯间合理保存了场景,但Quen-Image-Edit-2509和HunyuanImage-3.0都表现出了累积的视觉退化,后期输出逐渐失去结构完整性和视觉忠诚. 这表明多回合推理知情编辑中的错误不仅可以在推理层面积累,还可以通过多步视觉再生来积累,使长视距一致性成为除正确解决每个个体编辑之外的额外挑战.

blocks.en: 5 CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 5. 结 论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present RISEBench++, a comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), extending RISEBench with a hierarchical taxonomy spanning six fundamental reasoning dimensions, 12 subcategories, and 65 fine-grained task types. Built upon this taxonomy, RISEBench++ comprises 1,000 carefully curated and human-annotated bilingual test cases and supports comprehensive evaluation across single-image, multi-image, and multi-turn settings.
We establish an evaluation framework that jointly assesses instruction reasoning, appearance consistency, and visual plausibility, with LMM-based judgments validated against human assessments. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement.
Extensive experiments on 58 visual editing approaches reveal that, despite substantial progress in visual quality and appearance preservation, reasoning-informed editing remains challenging, with the strongest evaluated approach achieving only 56.6% accuracy.
In particular, inferring implicit visual rules, precisely executing reasoning-dependent transformations, and maintaining consistency across successive edits remain critical bottlenecks.
The results of RISE-Agent further demonstrate the promise of agentic approaches for reasoning-informed visual editing, highlighting agentic frameworks as an effective paradigm for tackling challenging editing tasks that require both complex reasoning and precise execution.
These findings suggest that advancing visual editing requires not only stronger generative capabilities, but also robust visual perception, sophisticated multimodal reasoning, and precise execution.
We hope that RISEBench++ and RISE-Agent provide a useful foundation for systematic evaluation and further research toward more capable and reliable reasoning-informed visual editing.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了RISE Bench++,这是理性-Informed viSual edit (RISE)的一个全面而精细的基准,它扩展了RISE Bench的分级分类学,涵盖六个基本推理维度,12个子类,65个精细的任务类型. RISE Bench++在这个分类法的基础上,由1 000个经过精心整理和人文说明的双语测试案例组成,支持在单一图像、多图像和多回合设置中进行全面评价。
我们建立了一个评估框架,联合评估指令推理、外观一致性和视觉可信性,根据基于LMM的判断与人类评估进行验证。 除了制定基准外,我们引入了RISE-Agent,这是一个无培训代理框架,将推理驱动规划、工具强化执行和核查指导改进结合起来。
关于58个视觉编辑方法的广泛实验表明,尽管在视觉质量和外观保存方面取得了实质性进展,但基于推理的编辑仍然具有挑战性,最强的评价方法只达到56.6%的准确性。
特别是,推断出隐含的视觉规则,精确地执行依赖推理的转变,并保持相继编辑的一致性仍然是关键的瓶颈.
RISE-Agent的成果进一步表明,在推理知情的视觉编辑中,具有代理性做法的希望,强调代理性框架是处理需要复杂推理和精确执行的具有挑战性的编辑任务的有效范例。
这些调查结果表明,推进视觉编辑不仅需要更强大的基因能力,而且需要强健的视觉感知,复杂的多模式推理,以及精确的执行.
我们希望,RISE Bench++和RISE-Agent为系统评价和进一步研究提供有益的基础,以便更有能力和更可靠地进行推理知情的视觉编辑。
